scope: Reviewed unsigned APK releaseRuntimeClasspath binary hashes checked against local frozen installation/cache. POM declarations are evidence, not proof of complete transitive/native license compliance. This is not the inventory of later APK builds.
openItems: Collect actual Metro bundle packages and linked native-source packages, rather than treating all installed development tools as APK dependencies.
Complete version-matched copyright/NOTICE for native libraries and their bundled dependencies, including Hermes/React Native/Fresco/libavif/libc++/zstd.
Review Android Install Referrer 2.2 terms and required distribution notices; its POM declares Android SDK terms, not Apache-2.0.
Verify rebuilt SuperLyricApi and jaudiotagger replacements in an actual unsigned APK; source availability alone does not prove relinking.
Bind the completed distribution materials to the final signed candidate APK; signing/device checks remain outside this audit.
